description: Sindh Abadgar's Sugar Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 28 January 1984 as a public limited company and is principally engaged in the manufacturing and sale of sugar. Its plant at Deh Deenpur, Taluka Bulri Shah Karim, District Tando Muhammad Khan in Sindh crushes 8,000 tons of cane a day and produces white refined crystal sugar of all grades and colours, including pharmaceutical grade, using Talofloc refining technology licensed from Tate & Lyle. The company states that it was the first in the sugar industry to obtain ISO 9001 certification, in 1997.
